compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen is from a fitness app, specifically the "Badges" section. The main content of this screen is a badge titled "Fit Quads," which is likely awarded for completing a specific fitness achievement related to quadriceps exercises. The badge is displayed prominently in the center of the screen. Below the badge, there is a motivational message encouraging the user to "Get it, test it, pump it..." and informing them that their friends will be able to see their effort on the website www.runtastic.com. The top of the screen has a back arrow to navigate to the previous screen, and the title "Badges" is displayed.
